{{Quote|Wake me when we have landed.|The near-Human mercenary, to Gyran|<ref name="Sisar Run 65" />}}
A '''near-Human mercenary''' was part of a team assembled by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] to hunt down [[Limna Yith]] and a stolen [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] on behalf of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Aboard team member [[Gyran]]'s [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Arc Razor]]'', they tracked Yith to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].
